hardwareClass: RTX 3060 Laptop GPU; actual device and driver recorded per run
configuration: Release preferred; RelWithDebInfo diagnostic measurements must disclose development differences

stress.claim: Capacity, cost scaling and recovery; no normal-game FPS claim

sampling.excludeFrames: Only declared warmup and readback retirement; retain all measured long frames
sampling.gpuEvidence: Completed timestamp queries plus submission identity; unavailable is not zero
sampling.overdrawProxy: Changed alpha-composited screen area versus no-effect capture; explicitly not fragment overdraw count

visual.crossBackend: Same seed, camera, fixed step, exposure, scene and resource hashes; no pixel-exact requirement
visual.review: Inspect temporal sequence, radius, orientation, blending, depth, readable telegraph and residuals; statistics alone cannot pass
